dory4b.reason: Excluded from this practical fine-tuning shortlist: experimental looped normalized-GPT, custom runtime and no validated A100 LoRA/QLoRA recipe in this project. This is not a claim that the model is inherently untrainable.

instruction: Staple den roten Würfel auf den blauen Würfel.
primary_attempt_rule: One attempt per planned trial; no automatic retries. Preserve technical, cancelled and partial attempts without replacing them or inventing scores.
sampling: Frozen native manufacturer profiles; compare configured systems, not an isolated weights-only ablation.
invariants: Two equal 40-mm axis-aligned cubes, same mass/friction/robot/controller/API/context layout, no examples or oracle solution in the model prompt. Only initial XY positions and generation seeds vary.
